notes: The page's Switch-it-off on the public path: lift, then the switch opens at 0.40 s; the winding current freewheels through the diode for well under a millisecond, then the shaft COASTS (i = 0) against the weight and viscous friction. Hand-derived before the first run: coasting w(t) = (w0 + tau/b) e^(-b t/J_eff) - tau/b with tau/b = 39.227 rad/s, b/J_eff = 1.515 /s, w0 ~ 18.68 rad/s: zero speed about 0.257 s after the opening, i.e. near 0.657 s — AFTER this 0.6 s run ends, so it stays inside the supported (no reverse) domain. At 0.6 s: w ~ 57.91 x e^(-1.515 x 0.199) - 39.23 ~ 3.6 rad/s. A longer run reverses and must be refused by the domain check (a negative in electromechanical-v1.test.ts).
